import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long P = 1000000007L;
    
    static class FiniteField {
        private long x;
        
        public FiniteField(long x) {
            if (x > P || x < 0) {
                System.err.println("Invalied FiniteField!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            this.x = x;
        }
        
        public FiniteField() {
            this.x = 0;
        }
        
        public long Value() {
            return x;
        }
        
        public FiniteField add(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(this.x);
            r.addAssign(o);
            return r;
        }
        
        public FiniteField subtract(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(this.x);
            r.subtractAssign(o);
            return r;
        }
        
        public FiniteField multiply(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(this.x);
            r.multiplyAssign(o);
            return r;
        }
        
        public FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(this.x);
            r.divideAssign(o);
            return r;
        }
        
        public void addAssign(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x + o.x) % P;
        }
        
        public void subtractAssign(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x + P - o.x) % P;
        }
        
        public void multiplyAssign(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x * o.x) % P;
        }
        
        public void divideAssign(FiniteField o) {
            long p = P - 2;
            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1) {
                    this.multiplyAssign(o);
                }
                o.multiplyAssign(o);
                p /= 2;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static List<List<FiniteField>> matrixMultiply(List<List<FiniteField>> a1, List<List<FiniteField>> a2) {
        int n = a1.size();
        int m = a1.get(0).size();
        if (a2.size() != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        int l = a2.get(0).size();
        List<List<FiniteField>> result = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            List<FiniteField> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(l, new FiniteField(0)));
            result.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    result.get(i).set(j, result.get(i).get(j).add(a1.get(i).get(k).multiply(a2.get(k).get(j))));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    static List<FiniteField> matrixVectorMultiply(List<List<FiniteField>> matrix, List<FiniteField> v) {
        int n = matrix.size();
        int m = matrix.get(0).size();
        if (v.size() != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix and vector dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        List<FiniteField> result = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, new FiniteField(0)));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                result.set(i, result.get(i).add(matrix.get(i).get(j).multiply(v.get(j))));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    static List<List<FiniteField>> make2DVector(int d1, int d2, FiniteField defaultValue) {
        List<List<FiniteField>> vec = new ArrayList<>(d1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<FiniteField> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d2, defaultValue));
            vec.add(row);
        }
        return vec;
    }
    
    static List<List<List<FiniteField>>> make3DVector(int d1, int d2, int d3, FiniteField defaultValue) {
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> vec = new ArrayList<>(d1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            vec.add(make2DVector(d2, d3, defaultValue));
        }
        return vec;
    }
    
    static final boolean DEBUG = false;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> shifts = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        }
        
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> units = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
        }
        
        List<List<FiniteField>> identity = make2DVector(d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
        }
        
        Map<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> cache = new HashMap<>();
        
        java.util.function.Function<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> findMatrix = new java.util.function.Function<>() {
            @Override
            public List<List<FiniteField>> apply(Long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }
                
                if (p <= d) {
                    List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = identity;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        matrix = matrixMultiply(units.get(k), matrix);
                    }
                    return matrix;
                }
                
                long childP = d;
                while ((p + childP - 1) / childP > d) childP *= d;
                List<List<FiniteField>> child = this.apply(childP);
                List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = copyMatrix(child);
                long remainingP = p;
                remainingP -= childP;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (remainingP >= childP) {
                        List<List<FiniteField>> temp = matrixMultiply(shifts.get(d - k), child);
                        temp = matrixMultiply(temp, shifts.get(k));
                        matrix = matrixMultiply(temp, matrix);
                        remainingP -= childP;
                    } else if (remainingP > 0) {
                        List<List<FiniteField>> temp = matrixMultiply(shifts.get(d - k), this.apply(remainingP));
                        temp = matrixMultiply(temp, shifts.get(k));
                        matrix = matrixMultiply(temp, matrix);
                        remainingP = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                cache.put(p, matrix);
                return matrix;
            }
        };
        
        if (DEBUG) System.err.println("PHASE 1");
        
        List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = findMatrix.apply(n);
        
        if (DEBUG) System.err.println("PHASE 2");
        
        List<FiniteField> baseVector = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d + 1, new FiniteField(0)));
        baseVector.set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        List<FiniteField> finalVector = matrixVectorMultiply(matrix, baseVector);
        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (FiniteField x : finalVector) ans = ans.add(x);
        System.out.println(ans.Value());
    }
    
    static List<List<FiniteField>> copyMatrix(List<List<FiniteField>> matrix) {
        List<List<FiniteField>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<FiniteField> row : matrix) {
            List<FiniteField> newRow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (FiniteField val : row) {
                newRow.add(new FiniteField(val.Value()));
            }
            result.add(newRow);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
